concurrency_and_state: Logger.WRITERS (EnumMap), Logger.TIME_FORMAT, and Logger.DATE_FORMAT are unsynchronized and accessed by both ServerLogWorker-Thread and the JVM shutdown hook thread during shutdown (drainQueue/checkDateRoll/writeEvent).
Logger.THROTTLE_MAP (ConcurrentHashMap<String, Long[]>) grows unboundedly without eviction and mutates Long[1] inside compute() while reading state[1] outside compute().

Util.dateFormat (SimpleDateFormat) in toDateString() and Util.num / Util.numShortFormat (NumberFormat) in format()/powerToString()/formatNumber() are shared static mutable formatters accessed without synchronization across threads.
BotTestLogger.log() and logException() synchronize on BotTestLogger.class while performing blocking FileWriter/PrintWriter disk I/O on every call.
cross_module_questions: Does Player.zone.map.yPhysicInTop or Zone initialization guarantee every mapId in 0..20 has at least one zone with zoneId != 0 (otherwise Util.randomAllMap loops infinitely)?
Are legacy plaintext passwords still present in the account table requiring PasswordUtils.verifyPassword() plaintext fallback, or can it be removed?
Do callers of Util.nextInt(int[] percen) handle the case where the sum of percentages is < 1000 and it returns percen.length?

findings.impact: Thread-safety violation: concurrent calls from Netty/game threads can corrupt SimpleDateFormat/NumberFormat internal state, producing garbled dates/numbers or throwing ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException/NumberFormatException.
findings.root_cause: Static SimpleDateFormat (dateFormat) and NumberFormat (num, numShortFormat) are used without ThreadLocal or synchronization (unlike compareDay which is synchronized).
findings.title: Unsynchronized shared SimpleDateFormat and NumberFormat in Util

findings.impact: Server thread hang (100% CPU infinite loop) if the randomly picked mapId (0..20) has no zone or only zoneId == 0.
findings.root_cause: mapId is selected once before the while(zoneJoin == null || zoneJoin.zoneId == 0) loop; getMapWithRandZone(mapId) is retried on the same mapId forever without a retry cap or re-rolling mapId.
findings.title: Potential infinite loop in Util.randomAllMap

findings.impact: Boss clone/random boss ID can become positive (0..100000), colliding with normal player or NPC IDs.
findings.root_cause: Initial bossId is Util.nextInt(-1000000, -100000), but the retry inside the while loop uses Util.nextInt(-1000000, 100000) with a positive upper bound.
findings.title: Wrong random upper bound in Util.randomBossId retry loop

findings.impact: Static memory leak over server uptime and potential ConcurrentModificationException/garbled logs during shutdown.
findings.root_cause: THROTTLE_MAP is never evicted/bounded (keys include player context + message). During shutdown, the hook thread runs drainQueue() without stopping/joining ServerLogWorker-Thread, racing on unsynchronized WRITERS EnumMap and SimpleDateFormat instances.
findings.title: Unbounded THROTTLE_MAP leak and shutdown race in Logger

findings.impact: Accounts with malformed BCrypt hashes or unmigrated hashes fall back to plaintext password comparison.
findings.root_cause: verifyPassword catches Exception around BCrypt.checkpw and falls back to password.equals(hashed), and also accepts non-BCrypt strings via plaintext equality.
findings.title: Plaintext password fallback in PasswordUtils.verifyPassword

findings.impact: ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException or NullPointerException on invalid skill level or null playerSkill/skillSelect.
findings.root_cause: getTempMobMe and getHPMobMe index 7-element arrays with (level - 1) without bounds checks; isUseSkillDam/isUseSkillChuong dereference player.playerSkill.skillSelect.template without null checks.
findings.title: Missing bounds and null checks in SkillUtil

findings.impact: NoSuchElementException or NullPointerException when inspecting a type-30 star stone with empty or null itemOptions.
findings.root_cause: getOptionDaPhaLe and getParamDaPhaLe call daPhaLe.itemOptions.getFirst() without checking if daPhaLe or itemOptions is null/empty.
findings.title: Unchecked itemOptions.getFirst() in CombineUtil

findings.impact: Integer overflow when lastTime is 0 or far in the past, and Util.contains returns false positives on substring matches.
findings.root_cause: TimeUtil casts (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastTime) / 1000 to int instead of long. Util.contains uses Arrays.toString(arr).contains(key) instead of element-wise equality.
findings.title: Int overflow in TimeUtil and substring bug in Util.contains

findings.impact: Unnecessary object allocations and blocking I/O on caller threads.
findings.root_cause: BotTestLogger opens/closes FileWriter per log line under class monitor; ItemUtil and Functions allocate new Random() per call; Util.haveSpecialCharacter compiles Pattern on every call.
findings.title: Repeated Random/Pattern allocations and per-call FileWriter in utils

findings.impact: External URL launch or unvalidated cmd execution if invoked in production.
findings.root_cause: ErrorRes.howToFix opens chatgpt.com with raw error text; FileRunner.runBatchFile passes batchFilePath directly to cmd /c start.
findings.title: Dev helper ErrorRes and unvalidated ProcessBuilder in FileRunner

key_classes.name: Logger
key_classes.responsibility: Async multi-category file logger with console output, error throttling, and player context formatting.

key_classes.name: Util
key_classes.responsibility: General-purpose math, RNG, distance, formatting, date, and map/boss helper utilities.

key_classes.name: SkillUtil
key_classes.responsibility: Skill template lookup, skill creation, pet skill upgrade, and item-to-skill mapping.

key_classes.name: CombineUtil
key_classes.responsibility: Item upgrade/socket (pha le hoa / nang cap) validation and cost/rate tables.

key_classes.name: TimeUtil
key_classes.responsibility: Date/time calculations, countdown formatting, and scheduled event window checks (Mabu, BlackBallWar).

key_classes.name: JsonUtil
key_classes.responsibility: Thread-safe Jackson ObjectMapper wrapper and safe JsonNode array accessors.

key_classes.name: PlayerAuditLogger
key_classes.responsibility: Structured player action, packet, skill, and combat audit logging via Logger.

key_classes.name: PasswordUtils
key_classes.responsibility: BCrypt password hashing and verification with legacy plaintext fallback.

module_summary: Batch server_services_bot_telemetry__p03 covers 15 utility classes in src/utils/ providing async/audit/bot logging, JSON serialization, BCrypt password hashing, system metrics, time/event helpers, skill/combine/item helpers, file I/O, and general RNG/formatting utilities.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Logs incoming/handled packet byte cmd and description to AUDIT log without reading/writing Message stream.
